heading: Form and style of work for departments
lead: The Director of the Government Publishing Office shall determine the form and style in which the printing or binding ordered by a department is executed, and the material and the size of type used, having proper regard to economy, workmanship, and the purposes for which the work is needed.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2014—Pub. L. 113–235 substituted “Director of the Government Publishing Office” for “Public Printer”.
